correctness.rationale: Sine-transform Plancherel gives exactly the displayed site Green integrals. Finite strictly decreasing scalar Birman–Schwinger functions give existence and uniqueness below the essential band. At criticality the free inverse of the point mass has squared norm integral N/omega^2, logarithmically divergent with one sine factor and finite with two. A polar integral gives the edge coefficient j^2/(4*pi), while dominated convergence gives the quadrant derivative B; the reciprocal-coupling Taylor expansion then supplies both energy scales. The actual packaged Python checker reproduces first-site Green values and an independent finite-difference sanity test. Numerical checks do not replace these analytic steps.
